summary: Read a sequence of n integers where n is less than 15000. A 132 shape means three indexes i, j, and k, with i earlier than j and j earlier than k, while the value at i is smaller than the value at k and the value at k is smaller than the value at j. Decide whether any such triple of indexes exists. Write true when it does and false when it does not.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
